props.description: A heavy hanging iron chain with empty wrist shackle, gently swinging left, center, right, center. Top link stays fixed.
A rusted wall-mounted iron brazier, amber flame flickering through four distinct shapes. Metal bracket remains identical and stationary.
A self-contained rectangular stone doorframe with iron portcullis: fully closed, one-third raised, two-thirds raised, fully open. Frame stays fixed; do not include a wall beyond the frame.
A compact wall-mounted iron winch and toothed wheel with a short captive chain, wheel rotates through four evenly spaced phases; mount stationary.
A short crimson torn banner hanging from a fixed horizontal iron bracket, four wind-blown cloth shapes, bracket stationary.
A short soot-black brick chimney with a SMALL attached smoke plume curling through four phases; no sprawling smoke cloud.
A compact pile of broken roof timbers with attached orange flames flickering; timbers stay identical and fixed.
A compact roof access hatch in a self-contained short slate-roof base, closed then partly opened then further opened then fully open; hinge and base stay fixed.
A single sealed glass voice vessel in a bronze cradle, pale teal mist swirls inside through four phases; no faces or figures, cradle stays fixed.
An antique bronze resonance bell hanging from a short fixed bracket, gently swings left-center-right-center; no detached sound rings.
A compact bronze and dark wood cabinet holding small sealed voice vessels, cabinet door goes closed, partly open, further open, fully open. Cabinet frame stays fixed.
A wall-mounted bronze acoustic resonator with inner patterned disk turning four phases, subtle pale teal inner glow, fixed outer ring.
An aged brass three-candle stand, small ivory candles with gently flickering flames; stand and wax forms stationary.
Tattered ivory ceremonial cloth hanging from a short fixed bronze rail, subtle wind through four distinct fabric positions, no real-world religious symbols.
A small self-contained empty stone shrine with incomplete halo ring and violet inner crystal light pulsing dim-bright-bright-dim; no person or religious symbol, stone stationary.
A freestanding compact pointed stone doorway with paired ivory metal doors opening closed, partly open, further open, fully open; frame stationary.
A freestanding cracked mirror in narrow silver guardian-style frame, a pale blue glint travels across its glass in four phases; no faces or reflected scenery, frame stationary.
A compact cluster of three mirror shards orbiting a small fixed dark metallic core; all shards stay close to the core within a compact silhouette, four clear positions.
A desaturated silver-gray torn guardian cloth standard on a short fixed wall bracket, gently ripples through four phases.
A self-contained framed circular mirror seal: intact, thin crack glow, central pieces folding away, open empty central ring. Outer frame stationary, no scattered flying debris.
One compact floating block of black stone with gold seams and two small closely orbiting fragments, four gentle bobbing phases; no sprawling debris.
A compact broken oval black-and-gold stone frame containing a narrow cold-blue reality fissure that pulses through four shapes, outer frame remains fixed.
A short hanging ornamental black-and-gold chain with pointed pendant, four gentle swaying positions with top link fixed.
A short self-contained black stone pillar with gold veins: intact, hairline cracks, widening cracks, top section sagging into compact rubble at the base. No debris outside the cell.

A compact freestanding black-and-gold dream engine: three offset incomplete metal rings rotating around an ember core on a fixed stone plinth, four phases, ancient gothic mechanism not futuristic technology.
A heavy black iron brazier with restrained gold trim, small ember-orange flames flickering through four phases; bowl and pedestal fixed.
A single empty heavy iron wrist shackle attached to a fixed short chain: locked, lock shifting, cuff partly opening, cuff fully open. No wrist or prisoner.
A short tattered black banner with simple tarnished gold trim hanging from a fixed iron rail, four slow cloth ripple phases, no text or crest lettering.
